tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the main column.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar background. Slightly deeper than bg so the list reads as its own column.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: composer, editor card, active tab, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Recessed tracks: the mode-tab track, the new-entry button in dark, hover rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines and pill badges that must be seen.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Outline of text inputs (composer, editor card). ≥3:1 against bg so the input's edge is visible (1.4.11).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, bg-sidebar and surface (13.9:1 / 14.4:1).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: subtitles, sidebar secondary actions (≥4.9:1 on every ground).

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Group labels, hints, counters, placeholders. Passes 4.5:1 on every ground in both themes (lowest: 4.64 on surface-muted).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand hue: send button, icons, the selected-tab bar, focus ring. Light terracotta is 3.7:1 on bg: never for text under 24px (use accent-strong).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Filled buttons that carry text (저장). Light needs the deeper terracotta to reach 5:1 with on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent / accent-strong fills.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The desk-lamp glow at the top of the main column. Invisible in light, a soft amber pool in dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions in list edit mode (삭제) and error text. ≥4.6:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: emotion-joy
tokens.usage: 기쁨. Sidebar dot, calendar dot, analysis card accent.

tokens.name: emotion-excitement
tokens.usage: 설렘.

tokens.name: emotion-calm
tokens.usage: 평온.

tokens.name: emotion-tired
tokens.usage: 지침. Lowest-contrast emotion in light; the dot-ring keeps its edge visible.

tokens.name: emotion-sad
tokens.usage: 슬픔.

tokens.name: emotion-anxious
tokens.usage: 불안.

tokens.name: emotion-angry
tokens.usage: 분노.

tokens.name: emotion-none
tokens.usage: Ring of a hollow dot: an entry with no emotion yet (정리 전 chat, isRecordOnly). Never a fill. ≥3:1 on bg-sidebar.

tokens.name: dot-ring
tokens.usage: 1px ring around every emotion dot. Light emotion fills are 2.1–2.9:1 on bg-sidebar; the ring gives the dot a ≥3:1 edge. Dark fills already pass, so the ring is clear there.

families.sans: "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: The one greeting on the new-entry screen, both themes. 26px on phones.

styles.name: memory-line
styles.sample: 어제 운동 다시 시작했다고 했죠. 오늘은요?
styles.usage: The one remembering line under the greeting. Display face, ink-secondary.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: Entry title on the 일기 and dialog titles, both themes.

styles.name: diary-body
styles.sample: 오늘은 회의가 길어서 조금 지쳤지만, 퇴근길 노을이 예뻤다.
styles.usage: Every 일기 and 내 글, both themes. The text a user rereads in a year: never shrink it below 16px.

styles.name: month-line
styles.usage: Calendar month summary. Emotion words in it are set in their emotion color at ≥24px or underlined in it below.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: 오늘 있었던 일을 편하게 얘기해 주세요

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 있었던 일도, 스친 생각도, 기분 한 줄도 괜찮아요.

styles.name: list-item
styles.usage: Sidebar entry titles; single line, ellipsis.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside the tab track; icon-to-badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: row gaps in the sidebar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (small), side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Main column gutter; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between greeting block, tabs and composer.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Editor card padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Top/bottom padding of the main column.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Sidebar rows, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, the mode-tab track (tabs inside use 9px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Composer and editor cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills (정리 전 badge) and the round send button.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The selected tab lifting off its track.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Composer and editor card. Dark relies on the border instead.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar at desktop widths; it collapses or becomes a drawer below 960px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the greeting, composer and editor column.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any tappable control.
